prompt: Write a short email thanking your former teacher, Mr. Okoye, for the reference letter that helped you get a place on a nursing degree. Keep it under 120 words.
answer:
Subject: Thank you for the reference

Dear Mr. Okoye,

I wanted to let you know that I have been offered a place on the nursing degree at Northgate University, and I start in September. The admissions team mentioned how helpful your reference letter was, and I am very grateful that you took the time to write it.

Your chemistry lessons were the reason I first became interested in health care, so it feels right that you helped me take this next step. I will let you know how my first year goes.

Thank you again for your support.

Best wishes,
Amara Chukwu

prompt: Write a 60 to 90 word product description for a bamboo cutting board with a juice groove and non-slip feet, aimed at home cooks.
answer: Meet the cutting board that keeps up with your cooking. Made from fast-growing bamboo, it is hard enough for daily chopping yet gentle on your knife edges. A deep juice groove catches runoff from tomatoes, fruit and roasts, so your counter stays clean, and four non-slip feet hold the board steady while you work. Rinse it with warm soapy water, dry it upright, and it is ready for tomorrow's dinner.
